## 🎯 Changes

Stacked on #7591, which adds `.errors()` to the procedure builder. This layer adds support to `@trpc/openapi` to emit those per-procedure shapes on a per-endpoint basis.

Today every operation points its `default` response at a single shared `#/components/responses/Error` built from the router-wide `errorFormatter`. A procedure that declares its own shapes with `.errors()` now gets an **inline** `default` response holding the union of everything it can return. Procedures on the router-wide shape keep the `$ref`.

## ✅ Checklist

- [x] I have followed the steps listed in the [Contributing guide](https://github.com/trpc/trpc/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] If necessary, I have added documentation related to the changes made.
- [x] I have added or updated the tests related to the changes made.

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * OpenAPI specifications now include procedure-specific error responses when procedures define custom error shapes, while retaining the shared error response where no specific shape applies.
  * Generated client types reflect documented error variants, including combined and duplicate error shapes.
* **Tests**
  * Added coverage for procedure-specific errors, chained handlers, multiple error shapes, and generated client types.
